provenance.labels_origin: exact human-assigned source labels; no DSEx labels were created

partition_contract.group_id: SHA-256 of case-folded, whitespace-normalized question text
partition_contract.heldout_overlap_policy: exclude a heldout group present anywhere in train
partition_contract.source_id: source split, immutable source-file digest prefix, and source row

brier_comparison.definition: mean((predicted probability of correctness - correctness indicator)^2)

limitations: This 400-question public TREC subset is a narrow operational benchmark, not a deployment calibration claim
Public TREC questions may have appeared in model training data; this run does not establish uncontaminated model capability
Prompt drift compares disjoint source sets and is descriptive, not a paired causal estimate
The empirical mapping must be refitted on representative source- and group-disjoint deployment data
provider_requirement: OpenAI Chat Completions with returned token logprobs
